newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus police launch manhunt after shooting.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus police launch manhunt after shooting.

text.p: Police in Cyprus have launched a manhunt for two men suspected of shooting and seriously wounding a gambling club owner in the coastal town of Larnaca on Thursday night, police said on Friday.
Greek Cypriot Antonis Phanieros, 56, was wounded in a volley of automatic fire as he was standing outside his club from a man riding pillion on a large motorcycle, police said.
Phanieros was shot in the head and neck. His condition is serious and he has been hospitalised in the intensive care unit of Nicosia general hospital.
A police patrol car which tried to stop a motorcycle for checks on the motorway linking capital Nicosia to the port town of Limassol came under automatic fire after the killing.
The fire hit the bonnet of the patrol. Its two occupants were unhurt.
Phanieros had previous run-ins with police and was widely seen to be a potential gangland target after a spate of unsolved gangster killings on the island two years ago.
